message_types.name: BLEBeaconSeen
message_types.description: Semantic BLE presence event emitted when a configured beacon becomes stably present.

properties.name: beacon_id
properties.description: Canonical beacon identity (e.g. ibeacon:UUID:major:minor).

properties.name: protocol
properties.description: Protocol family: ibeacon or eddystone.

properties.name: gateway_node_id
properties.description: Edge gateway node where the BLE scanner detected the tag.

properties.name: zone_id
properties.description: Semantic reference zone where the tag is present.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Current presence state (always SEEN for this event).

properties.name: seen_at
properties.description: RFC3339 timestamp when presence became stable.

properties.name: rssi_raw
properties.description: Raw un-smoothed RSSI measurement in dBm.

properties.name: rssi_filtered
properties.description: Smoothed RSSI in dBm from Kalman or EMA filter.

properties.name: distance_estimate_m
properties.description: Approximate log-distance path loss estimate in meters.

properties.name: tx_power
properties.description: Calibrated or advertised TX power at 1 meter in dBm.

properties.name: ibeacon_uuid
properties.description: 128-bit Proximity UUID of the iBeacon.

properties.name: ibeacon_major
properties.description: iBeacon major grouping number.

properties.name: ibeacon_minor
properties.description: iBeacon minor individual number.

properties.name: observation_count
properties.description: Number of consecutive observations accumulated during candidate dwell.

properties.name: scanner_backend
properties.description: Driver backend used by scanner: tinygo or mock.

message_types.name: BLEBeaconLost
message_types.description: Semantic BLE absence event emitted when an active beacon exceeds the absence silence window.

properties.name: beacon_id
properties.description: Canonical beacon identity (e.g. ibeacon:UUID:major:minor).

properties.name: protocol
properties.description: Protocol family: ibeacon or eddystone.

properties.name: gateway_node_id
properties.description: Edge gateway node that was tracking the beacon.

properties.name: zone_id
properties.description: Last known semantic reference zone.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Current presence state (always LOST for this event).

properties.name: last_seen_at
properties.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last received physical radio packet.

properties.name: lost_at
properties.description: RFC3339 timestamp when absence silence threshold expired.

properties.name: absence_window_ms
properties.description: Configured silence window in milliseconds that triggered the event.

properties.name: last_rssi_filtered
properties.description: Last filtered RSSI value in dBm recorded before loss.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Reason for transition (e.g. ABSENCE_TIMEOUT).

properties.name: ibeacon_uuid
properties.description: 128-bit Proximity UUID of the iBeacon.

properties.name: ibeacon_major
properties.description: iBeacon major grouping number.

properties.name: ibeacon_minor
properties.description: iBeacon minor individual number.

message_types.name: BLEPluginConfig
message_types.description: Configuration for the BLE presence scanner plugin on edge gateway node.

properties.name: gateway_node_id
properties.description: Target edge gateway node id where plugin executes.

properties.name: adapter
properties.description: Bluetooth HCI adapter name (e.g. hci0).

properties.name: scanner_backend
properties.description: Driver backend: tinygo (physical radio) or mock (CI fallback).

properties.name: presence_window_ms
properties.description: Minimum continuous dwell time in ms before declaring presence.

properties.name: absence_window_ms
properties.description: Silence timeout in ms before declaring absence/lost.

properties.name: reference_zone
properties.description: Reference zone node ID (e.g. operation-room).

properties.name: reference_locagram
properties.description: Locagram of reference zone (e.g. /root/node-dell-2/operation-room).

properties.name: zone_center_x
properties.description: Local Cartesian X coordinate in meters for the zone center.

properties.name: zone_center_y
properties.description: Local Cartesian Y coordinate in meters for the zone center.
